title: Fix explainer glossary, card titles, lede, and claim source issues
summary: Respond to the newcomer's 4/5 rating by changing the explainer generator (xtask/src/site.rs) and the firstmate-work-handling study data. Define or link the Start-here terms, add and sort Glossary entries, title the ra1–ra6 cards, explain the lede id, dedupe and order claim sources, and add generator tests for each.

defaults_applied.how: Add generator tests for sorted glossary, no repeated claim source, ordered claims; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Criteria check the rendered page output, not just that data exists.
Sorting, deduping and ordering are done in the generator so they hold for any study, not only the instances found.
Definitions are written plainly for an outside reader.
One focused change to the generator and study data.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Audience is a newcomer reading the published page top to bottom; the goal is that terms are defined before use.

Page is generated by xtask/src/site.rs from studies/firstmate-work-handling/*.json; fixes go in the generator where they are systematic (sort, dedupe, order) and in the data where content is needed (glossary entries, card titles, intro).
If study JSON is hashed or validated by the study capability, edits must keep validation.json consistent.
Card titles may be added as a new field in rationales.json or a generator-side map; the producer picks whichever the schema allows.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: the new generator tests pass, covering Glossary sorted alphabetically, no claim listing the same source twice, and claims in numeric order (c33 before c34).
Run cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check: both clean.
In the generated page, captain, yolo, green, red and local-only landing are defined at first use in 'Start here' or link to Glossary entries; the Glossary has entries for green, red and home.
Glossary entries render in alphabetical order, and claims render in numeric order with no claim showing a repeated source (c2, c14, c42 fixed).
Each design-choice card ra1–ra6 shows a short descriptive title alongside its id.
The lede either explains the internal id firstmate-work-handling or no longer shows it unexplained.
Run cargo run for the site generator xtask (as documented) and confirm the output page contains the new titles and definitions; the generator must still validate the study.

out_of_scope: Changing the study's claims or conclusions
Changes to other studies or the audience-rating records
Redesigning the page layout beyond the listed fixes
departures: Slightly higher cost and time than reference: multi-file edit across generator and study data with several tests; I did not read site.rs in detail.
